tools.name: find_locations
tools.description: Look up location codes for a city, county, state or country (free). Use the returned location_code in start_search.

tools.name: suggest_keywords
tools.description: Turn a niche into matching Google business categories and sharper search keywords (free). Helps avoid off-niche results.

tools.name: start_search
tools.description: Start an async search for local businesses by keyword in up to 5 locations, then enrich each one. Spends 1 credit per business with a website (website-less and off-niche listings are free). Returns a job_id; poll get_job. Call once per search: every call starts a new paid job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status and counts for a search or enrichment job (queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled). Poll every ~5 seconds.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Enriched businesses for a job, paginated. Pass next_cursor from the previous page to continue.

tools.name: enrich_domains
tools.description: Enrich up to 100 businesses you already have, by website domain: owner name, checked emails, phone line type, tech. Spends 1 credit per domain (recently enriched domains are free). Returns a job_id.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, credit balance and phone line-type allowance.

tools.name: check_website_tech
tools.description: Free: detect the CMS, analytics, ad pixels, chat and booking tools a single website runs.
